decisions.evidence: Overall, despite the unfavorable polarity and ionization burden, the combination of tertiary aliphatic amine (1), strongest basic pKa of 6.8004, Labute surface area of 192.7325, and aryl chloride (1) provides enough supportive evidence that the molecule is more likely to have oral bioavailability at or above 20%.
Because the positive-neighbor evidence is strong and the negative-neighbor evidence is mixed rather than decisive, the overall comparison supports option (B): has oral bioavailability ≥20%.
